table.name: TLGNR_SILO_TYPE_BS
table.description: Possible types for a silo. Possible types: Standard silo or Pressure silo.

column.name: SILO_TYPE_CD
column.description: PK. Code of the Reference Data. 1=Standard silo (Standsilo), 2=Pressure silo (Drucksilo).

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
